verdict.rationale: Thoropass ships a native Risk Register that replaces spreadsheets. It offers configurable 4×4 or 5×5 risk scoring and lets you track, evaluate and remediate risks. A dedicated role can manage assigned risks, including the controls and action items linked to them, which covers scoring, owners and ties back to controls. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of risk treatment-plan structure (only implied via action items and remediation), any evidence of periodic risk review cycles or reminders, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
